title: A repeating Shopify product watchlist
description: Check specific public Shopify product pages. Persistent history stays in the running user's account under monitorName. $0.002 per saved successful check, including NO_ALERT; failures have no check event. No automatic message delivery.

productUrls.title: Product URLs
productUrls.description: 1?100 HTTPS Shopify /products/handle page URLs. Remove query/variant/tracking parameters. Store roots, collection URLs and nonstandard ports are rejected. Locale prefixes such as /en-gb are supported. Same URL continues its baseline.

monitorName.title: Monitor name ? keep this for scheduled runs
monitorName.description: Unique watchlist name in your own account. Actor automatically remembers saved successful checks between runs. New names start fresh history. Same-name overlapping runs fail before website requests/check fees.

maxProducts.title: Maximum successful/attempted products to select
maxProducts.description: Select the first N unique input URLs. Spending limit and a 240-second pipeline deadline can reduce work further. Skipped products keep prior state and have no check event.

minPriceChangePercent.title: Minimum price alert movement (%)
minPriceChangePercent.description: Only price-rise/drop alerts are filtered. Compared to the immediately preceding saved check, not cumulative movement. Stock/currency/compare-at alerts are not filtered. Successful checks still cost $0.002 and update baseline, even without alerts.

timeoutSeconds.title: Per-request timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: TLS-verified requests with robots and at least one second between requests to a host. No login/proxy/bypass.
